title: Securing Wireless Sensor Networks Through Explainable Machine Learning-Based Intrusion Detection
summary: A Flask-based web application that detects intrusion attacks (Blackhole, Flooding, Grayhole, TDMA) in wireless sensor networks using a Random Forest model and SHAP explainability visualizations. Its requirements.txt lists sdv, ctgan, rdt, sdmetrics, and copulas as dependencies, but no code in the evidence imports or calls any of them.
